title: Snowflake Launches Serverless Platform for Training Open-Weight AI Models
summary:
The cloud company's new Cortex Training service allows developers to build and deploy customized versions of open-weight models without managing the underlying GPU infrastructure. The platform gives AI teams control over reinforcement learning, supervised fine-tuning and custom training loops while the company handles the hardware operations usually required to run GPU clusters.

The offering integrates with the OpenHands agent harness to let developers post-train models using their existing agent tasks and configurations. Cortex Training was developed over the course of this year by Snowflake's AI Research team and its Arctic RL group.
